answer: Streak multipliers at the quill: each identity's voting weight = base stake × log2(1 + consecutive-epoch streak). One epoch of inactivity resets the streak to zero. The kernel enforces this by rejecting ballots from identities whose last 5 epochs show gaps. Fresh sybils start at weight 1; a 32-epoch streak yields 6× weight, so an attacker needs 32× the capital to match one veteran. The pigment of farm economics: forging 100 identities with no history costs 100× stake for 1× influence. Conclusion: linear cost against logarithmic reward makes farming unprofitable before break-even.
